account.name: Sample LEAPS + small-cap book
account.strategy: LEAPS (>45 DTE, ideally 6-18 months) on liquid large caps with reasonably priced IV; shares only on smaller caps where options are illiquid or IV is too rich. Beaten-down names with a dated catalyst; stagger catalyst windows and sectors.
account.risk_tolerance: Aggressive but capped: max loss per options position = premium paid; no single name above 25% of NAV.
